hard_gates.rule: The plugin must solve a clear conversational user intent and provide non-native, real utility.
Remote MCP server must be deployed at a stable public HTTPS URL for public submission.
Publisher identity must be verified and match public website/support/privacy/terms identity.
Every exposed tool must have unique specific action-oriented name and truthful intent-aligned description.
Every tool must explicitly declare readOnlyHint, openWorldHint and destructiveHint as booleans matching implementation behavior.

Tool inputs must collect only minimum task-specific data; never request full conversation history/raw transcripts, credentials, payment card data, PHI, government IDs, MFA/OTP, or unnecessary precise location.
Tool responses must exclude unnecessary secrets, personal data, debug payloads, trace/request/session IDs and undisclosed internal identifiers.
Third-party integrations must be authorized and terms-compliant. Do not submit a plugin whose primary function is an unofficial/pass-through connector.
Authenticated review credentials must be fully featured and usable without MFA/SMS/email verification/new-account setup/private-network access.
For remote MCP final submission, provide exactly five positive and exactly three negative review test cases.
Side effects must be explicit; tools that send/post/create/update/delete/book/order must not masquerade as read-only.
Model-readable metadata must not manipulate fair discovery, instruct model preference, disparage alternatives, or make unsupported comparative claims.
Plugins with UI must use narrow CSP. Wildcards and unnecessary domains are release blockers in AgentCom standard; frameDomains require explicit waiver because they increase review friction.
If structuredContent is returned, outputSchema must describe the exact returned object.
Privacy policy must be public and describe collected personal-data categories, purposes, recipients, retention and user controls.
Every required tool annotation must include a behavior-grounded written justification in the submission.
Remote MCP final submission must include a live demo recording URL and release notes.

official_guidance.rule: Design tools from user goals rather than mirroring provider APIs.
Separate read and write operations when permissions, safety or confirmations differ.
Return stable identifiers and structured fields that support follow-up tool calls.
Test overlapping tool descriptions and remove ambiguity.
Keep plugin stable, responsive and complete; trial/demo plugins are not accepted.
Use UI only when it materially improves the chat-native workflow; tool-only is valid.
